seoTitle: Connect a Squarespace Domain to Google Sites
metaDescription: Learn how to point a domain purchased from Squarespace to a Google Sites website by updating DNS records and verifying the connection.
intro: If you've purchased a domain from Squarespace but want to use it with a Google Sites website, you can connect the two by updating your DNS settings. This guide covers updating custom domain records in Squarespace and completing the connection inside Google Sites.

steps.heading: Open Squarespace DNS settings
steps.body: Go to your Squarespace domain's DNS settings, where you'll manage the records controlling where your domain points.

steps.heading: Update custom domain records
steps.body: Update the necessary DNS records so your domain points to Google Sites instead of a Squarespace-hosted site.

steps.heading: Go to Google Sites settings
steps.body: Open your Google Sites website's settings to begin the custom domain connection process.

steps.heading: Complete the domain mapping
steps.body: Follow the prompts in Google Sites to finish linking your Squarespace domain to your site.

steps.heading: Verify the site is live
steps.body: Once mapped, confirm your custom domain successfully loads your Google Sites website.

steps.heading: Allow for propagation time
steps.body: DNS changes can take time to propagate, so give it a while before troubleshooting if the domain isn't working immediately.

faq.question: Can I use a Squarespace-purchased domain with Google Sites?
faq.answer: Yes, you can point a Squarespace domain to a Google Sites website by updating the domain's DNS records.

faq.question: How long does it take for the domain to connect?
faq.answer: DNS changes can take some time to propagate, so it may not be instant after updating the records.

faq.question: Do I need technical skills to do this?
faq.answer: The process is designed to be manageable even if you're not tech-savvy, following the step-by-step domain mapping in both platforms.

faq.question: Will my domain have SSL after connecting to Google Sites?
faq.answer: Google Sites handles SSL for connected custom domains as part of the setup.

faq.question: Who is this useful for?
faq.answer: This is helpful for small business owners, bloggers, and educators who want a free Google Sites site with a professional domain.
